title: 第1714章 都是抢第1713章 反被压制
lines: 眼睁睁的看着黑牛快速离去，转眼间彻底消失不见。
一屁股坐在地上，林铮脸上写满了不甘心和愤怒，却是没有任何的办法。
“不愿意？”
“鸢姐，黑牛始终都是仙君境，放虎归山，对我来说始终没有好处。”
“我明白，但我刚刚已经说了，你们之间的境界差距太大了，要是你死咬着他不放，将他逼的太急，对于你来说没有任何的好处，为了他出现意外，肯定是不值得的事情。”
一声叹息！
机会和危险并存，自己害怕自身陨落而无法全力出手，才使得自己没有机会斩杀黑牛。
“要是没有十足把握的情况下，相信此人不会再回来对付你。”
希望如此。
“鸢姐，瑶妹怎么样了。”
“自从她觉醒了先天不灭剑体后，她的天赋强的可怕，只要她好好的修炼，我可以保证，日后的她所能达到的成就，必定会超过我。”
听到此话的林铮显得很是惊讶。
她当然知道沈烟鸢是什么修为，巅峰仙帝境，能够超过沈烟鸢，说明瑶妹日后岂不是可以问鼎封号仙帝境。
要真是如此的话，那么自己这次算是捡到宝了。
毕竟瑶妹的实力越强，对自己越是有利。
似乎能够猜出林铮心中所想，沈烟鸢说道：“林铮，我丑话说到前面，瑶妹既然拜我为师，那她永远都是我的弟子，无论以后发生什么事情，你都不能利用她。”
“可以。”
“我会暂时闭关相助瑶妹修炼，要是没有什么特殊的情况，你不要随意来打扰。”
切断和锁帝图的联系，林铮也没有闲着。
没有继续纠结黑牛的事情。
这次虽然没有重创黑牛，但正如沈烟鸢所说，要是自己和黑牛一直斗下去的话，自己未必能够全身而退。
没有必要和黑牛生死搏斗，要是自己出现意外的话，对于自己来说完全是不值得的事情。
自己是瓷器，而黑牛却是烂泥。
等到自己日后的修为提升起来，或者是分身能够更进一步，顺利晋级到仙君境，到时候再遇到黑牛，在自己出手相助的情况下，说不定可以顺利的斩杀黑牛。
现在的自己，要做的事情，就是以最快的速度赶往幽阙宫。
虽然沈烟鸢没有保证，但林铮能看的出来，既然沈烟鸢让自己前往幽阙宫，肯定是对自身的宗门有着十足的把握。
但凡没有把握的情况下，相信沈烟鸢也不会轻易让自己前往幽阙宫。
自己初来乍到，要是能够找到幽阙宫这样的靠山，对于自己来说绝对是最有利的事情。
直接召唤出佛莲飞船，林铮连想都没有想，直接乘坐佛莲飞船快速而去，毕竟佛莲飞船的速度远远凌驾于自己的脚力之上。
夜幕下。
浩瀚的佛力瞬间涌来，开始狠狠的压制住佛莲飞船，正在全力飞行的佛莲，竟然被硬生生的逼停。
林铮显得很是惊讶，因为他实在是没有想到，会有人突然对自己出手，不过没有离开佛莲飞船，他不知道外面到底是什么情况。
“阿弥陀佛，还请施主出来。”
content_en:
He watched helplessly as the black cow left quickly and disappeared completely in the blink of an eye.
Sitting on the ground, Lin Zheng's face was full of unwillingness and anger, but there was nothing he could do.
"Don't want to?"
"Sister Yuan, Hei Niu will always be in the realm of the Immortal Lord. It will never be good for me to let the tiger return to the mountains."
"I understand, but as I said just now, the gap between your realms is too big. If you insist on him and push him too hard, it will not do you any good. If something happens to him, it will definitely not be worth it."
A sigh!
Opportunities and dangers coexisted. He was afraid of his own death and could not take action with all his strength, so he had no chance to kill the black bull.
"If you are not completely sure, I believe this person will not come back to deal with you again."
Hope so.
"Sister Yuan, how is Yao sister?"
"Ever since she awakened the Innate Immortal Sword Body, her talent has been terrifyingly strong. As long as she practices well, I can guarantee that her achievements in the future will definitely surpass mine."
Lin Zheng looked very surprised when he heard this.
Of course she knew what kind of cultivation Shen Yanyuan was. He could surpass Shen Yanyuan at the peak Immortal Emperor realm, which meant that Yaomei could aspire to the title of Immortal Emperor realm in the future.
If this is really the case, then I have found a treasure this time.
After all, the stronger Yaomei is, the more beneficial it is to herself.
Seemingly able to guess what Lin Zheng was thinking, Shen Yanyuan said: "Lin Zheng, let's talk about my ugly words. Since Yao Mei worships me as her teacher, she will always be my disciple. No matter what happens in the future, you can't take advantage of her."
"Okay."
"I will temporarily retreat to help Yao Mei practice. If there are no special circumstances, please don't disturb me at will."
"Okay."
After cutting off the connection with Suo Ditu, Lin Zheng was not idle either.
I didn’t continue to worry about the black bull.
Although Hei Niu was not seriously injured this time, as Shen Yanyuan said, if he and Hei Niu continued to fight, he might not be able to escape unscathed.
There is no need to fight to the death with the black bull. If something happens to him, it will be completely unworthy for him.
He is porcelain, but the black cow is mud.
When his cultivation level improves in the future, or when his avatar can advance further and successfully advance to the Immortal Lord Realm, when he encounters the Black Bull again, with his help, he might be able to successfully kill the Black Bull.
What I have to do now is to rush to Youque Palace as quickly as possible.
Although Shen Yanyuan had no guarantee, Lin Zheng could see that since Shen Yanyuan asked him to go to Youque Palace, he must have full confidence in his sect.
Whenever there is uncertainty, I believe that Shen Yanyuan will not let herself go to Youque Palace easily.
As a new arrival, it would definitely be the most beneficial thing for me if I could find a backer like Youque Palace.
Directly summoning the Buddha Lotus Spaceship, Lin Zheng didn't even think about it, and flew away quickly on the Buddha Lotus Spaceship. After all, the speed of the Buddha Lotus Spaceship was far greater than his own foot strength.
Under night.
The vast Buddha's power surged in instantly and began to suppress the Buddha Lotus spaceship. The Buddha Lotus, which was flying at full speed, was forced to stop abruptly.
Lin Zheng looked very surprised, because he really didn't expect that someone would suddenly attack him, but he didn't leave the Fulian spacecraft, so he didn't know what was going on outside.
"Amitabha, please come out."
